findings: blocking: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-apply-live-rulings-run.py:1146 — the brief required calling the quiet-graph probe immediately before applying and refusing when the graph is not quiet, but the apply mode invokes _signed_call(True, args.digest) unconditionally: quiet_graph_check() is a separate recorded mode and nothing consults it before a write, so the guard is captured, not enforced.
